name: oneonone_rival_seed
note: Manual prerequisite for oneonone_rival_region on the same database. This run enters 1on1 (MID 2480) and saves three one-girl teams through MID 2481, so the next run has a rival with a defense and an earlier Junior reach. Not part of vc_suite.sh: the pair shares one VCDB and must run seed then region.
steps: lua:local p=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.SELF_PLAYER) local f={} for _,h in pairs(p:getHeros()) do if #f<3 then f[#f+1]=tostring(h:getHeroID()) end end assert(#f==3,'vc-seed-heroes-'..#f) xyd.Backend.get():request(xyd.mid.PEAK_CHANGE_TEAMS,{formations=f},function(code) if code~=xyd.error.OK then error('vc-seed-change-'..tostring(code)) end __vcSeedSaved=true end)
